items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: My wife's brother, yeah the one I showed you on that picture, the Detroit picture, yeah. He was the one playing clarinet.

ctx.x: You mentioned the clarinet player with Rene, did he have any particular clarinet player that he'd use more than anybody else?

Well at the time when I played with him, my brother and I was playing clarinet. Oh that's right. My wife's brother, yeah the one I showed you on that picture, the Detroit picture, yeah. He was the one playing clarinet. What was your name?
